decisions.reason: A same-message MODIFY already replaces the obsolete no-Discord support copy with Discord as an available community and support channel. The server's moderation, welcome-bot, and invite configuration need not be reproduced in the FAQ.
Creating and configuring a Discord community server does not designate Discord as a prize-winner notification channel; the existing Winners page, dashboard, and email rules remain unchanged.
Discord community configuration does not affect mint tipping amounts, transactions, safeguards, or UI disclosure.
The mission page's general community language remains valid without adding Discord setup details or an invite link.
Discord server setup is unrelated to the token standard, marketplace whitelist, and secondary royalty enforcement.
The About page's descriptive references to a community do not require modification merely because a Discord server is being configured.
Discord community settings do not change NFT metadata fields, counters, badges, or reward-accounting consistency.
Discord server configuration does not alter the mint price or allocation of mint revenue.
Discord setup has no effect on the book, referral identity, badges, or prize-ticket state transferred during NFT resale.
The Discord decision does not change Small Block funding, eligibility, ticket reset, draw frequency, or prize amount.
Discord community configuration does not affect the deferred Transak provider choice, supported payment methods, or fiat conversion flow.
Discord welcome and moderation setup does not change referral badge triggers, milestones, or on-chain badge recording.
